participation.context: Answered the question without restoring the scene, and wrote three lines.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Brought the ale, asked about the king, read a cue, and was sent back to school.
participation.name: Edmund Shakespeare

relations.note: he wants the stage, and is told to finish school

story.body: You refused Edmund the scene itself. He read a cue-word. You kept the writing to three fair lines and did not arrange a life for him.

relations.note: he wants the stage, and is told to finish school

title: Told Edmund the scene was cut and sent him to school

participation.context: Wrote three lines one-handed, and set the pen down.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You made three lines fair and left the rest blot.
